entries.267d3028bb77fc06: This is a paid support service that assists with the introduction and operation of “TeamSpirit.” It includes spot support and premium support. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥900 million.
entries.4febadfc91c678c4: Operates "TeamSpirit", a cloud service that provides attendance management, man-hour management and expense settlement on 1 platform.

entries.83aa88ad08cf0ec0: This is a subscription offering of the “TeamSpirit” series. There are “TeamSpirit Enterprise,” for companies with 1,000 or more employees, and separate attendance, man-hour and expense services for small and mid-sized companies, and the company also provides linked services such as project cost management and assignment management. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥4,021 million.
